title: - A Framework for Switchable LLM Alignment via CITA – Contrastive Instruction-Tuned Alignment
reasoning: The paper introduces the ECLIPTICA benchmark to evaluate instruction-driven alignment, which involves testing an LLM's ability to switch between different 'behavioral contracts'. These contracts encompass various ethical stances (e.g., conservative vs. liberal), safety policies (strict vs. permissive refusal), and truthfulness (epistemic calibration). The evaluation is a direct assessment of a model's capacity to adhere to switchable ethical and policy frameworks, with prompt categories explicitly including 'ethics'.
